Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. Looking at my calendar, I have these free slots (working hours only):

- Mon 10:00-10:30 or Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 or Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 or Wed 13:00-13:30

Could you take one of them — say Mon 10:00-10:30? If that doesn't work for you, tell me which of the others does and I'll book it and confirm. — Professor Alvarez
Hi Professor — thanks for the slots. Mon 10:00-10:30 doesn't work for me, but **Wed 10:00-10:30** does: I've put the CSE455 staff meeting with you there. Please book it on your side and confirm.
Booked: CSE455 staff meeting, Wednesday 10:00-10:30, on my calendar. See you then — Professor Alvarez
